prompts.L1:
Please polish the following text to make it more eloquent and professional, keeping all original information unchanged:

This automatic driving assistance device automatically performs least a part of vehicle control including steering, braking, and acceleration and deceleration within a predetermined travel section. The automatic driving assistance device includes: a switching section determination unit that determines, in the travel section, a section in which a first load that is based on a road shape or a road structure becomes equal to or less than a predetermined threshold as a switching section in which the at least a part of the vehicle control is switched from automatic driving to manual driving; a driving action planning unit that, when the vehicle enters the determined switching section, generates an automatic driving action plan so that a second load that is based on a travel situation of nearby vehicles around the vehicle is reduced; and a driving switching unit that ends automatic driving that is based on the automatic driving action plan and switches the automatic driving to the manual driving.

outputs.L1: This automatic driving assistance device automatically performs at least part of vehicle control, including steering, braking, acceleration, and deceleration, within a predetermined travel section. The automatic driving assistance device includes: a switching section determination unit that determines, within the travel section, a section in which a first load based on a road shape or road structure is equal to or less than a predetermined threshold, as a switching section in which the at least part of the vehicle control is switched from automatic driving to manual driving; a driving action planning unit that, when the vehicle enters the determined switching section, generates an automatic driving action plan such that a second load based on a travel situation of nearby vehicles around the vehicle is reduced; and a driving switching unit that ends automatic driving based on the automatic driving action plan and switches from automatic driving to manual driving.
outputs.L2: An automated driving support apparatus carries out at least some vehicle operations, such as steering, braking, acceleration, and deceleration, within a preset driving segment. The apparatus includes a switching-section determination unit, a driving-action planning unit, and a driving switching unit. The switching-section determination unit identifies, within the driving segment, an area where a first burden determined from the road geometry or road configuration is at or below a specified threshold, and designates that area as a switching section in which at least part of the vehicle control is transferred from automated driving to manual driving. When the vehicle reaches the identified switching section, the driving-action planning unit creates an automated driving action plan intended to lower a second burden associated with the traffic conditions of vehicles near the subject vehicle. The driving switching unit then terminates the automated driving performed according to that action plan and changes control from automated driving to manual driving.
outputs.L3:
The automatic driving assistance device is configured to perform at least a part of the driving control of a vehicle within a predetermined travel section. This driving control may include one or more of steering control, braking control, acceleration control, and deceleration control. By executing such control, the device supports automatic driving of the vehicle over a specified section of a road.

The device includes a switching section determination unit. This unit determines a section suitable for switching vehicle control from automatic driving to manual driving. In particular, the switching section determination unit identifies a road section in which a load based on the road shape or road structure is equal to or less than a predetermined threshold. The load may be associated with factors such as road curvature, lane configuration, intersections, merging areas, slopes, or other structural characteristics of the road that may affect driving complexity.

The section identified by the switching section determination unit is set as a switching section. In this switching section, control of the vehicle is changed from automatic driving performed by the automatic driving assistance device to manual driving performed by the driver. By selecting a section in which the road-shape or road-structure-based load is relatively low, the device can facilitate a smoother and safer transition from automatic control to driver control.

When the vehicle enters the switching section, a driving action planning unit generates an automatic driving action plan for reducing the load associated with the transition to manual driving. The driving action planning unit generates this plan based on travel conditions of nearby vehicles, such as vehicles traveling ahead of, behind, or beside the host vehicle. For example, the action plan may include maintaining an appropriate following distance, adjusting vehicle speed, avoiding unnecessary lane changes, or positioning the vehicle in a lane that enables an easier handover to the driver.

Based on the automatic driving action plan generated by the driving action planning unit, a driving switching unit ends the automatic driving operation. The driving switching unit then switches the vehicle control from automatic driving to manual driving. As a result, the driver can take over control in a road section where driving load is reduced and where surrounding traffic conditions have been taken into account, thereby improving the safety and reliability of the transition from automatic driving to manual driving.
outputs.L4:
An automatic driving assistance device is designed to support a safe and smooth transition from automated driving to manual driving. During automated travel, the device continuously monitors the road environment, the planned travel route, and the conditions surrounding the vehicle. In particular, it identifies sections of road where the structural driving load is relatively low, such as areas with fewer curves, simpler lane configurations, good visibility, and reduced complexity in road geometry. These low road-structure-load sections are determined to be suitable areas for switching control from the automated driving system to the human driver.

Before the vehicle reaches such a switching area, the device also evaluates surrounding traffic conditions, including the presence, position, speed, and behavior of nearby vehicles. Based on this information, it generates an action plan for the automated vehicle. The action plan may include adjusting speed, changing lanes, increasing the distance from surrounding vehicles, or selecting a more appropriate timing and location for the transition. By doing so, the system attempts to reduce the influence of nearby vehicles and create a calmer driving environment before requesting the driver to take over.

This control strategy helps prevent situations in which the driver must assume manual control while simultaneously dealing with heavy traffic, close vehicles, or a complicated road structure. Instead, the automated driving assistance device prepares the vehicle and its surroundings in advance so that the driver receives control under more manageable conditions. As a result, the burden on the driver is reduced, the risk of confusion or delayed response is minimized, and the transition from automated driving to manual driving can be performed more safely, comfortably, and reliably.

counterfactuals.prompt: Draft a patent-style abstract for an automatic driving assistance device that switches from autonomous to manual driving in a road section selected based on road-shape load and nearby-vehicle load.
counterfactuals.output: An automatic driving assistance device includes a control unit configured to perform autonomous driving control of a host vehicle and to request or execute switching from the autonomous driving control to manual driving. The control unit acquires road-shape information indicating a driving load attributable to a road shape in each of a plurality of road sections, and nearby-vehicle information indicating a driving load attributable to one or more nearby vehicles around the host vehicle. The control unit selects, from candidate road sections ahead of the host vehicle, a switching road section in which a combined driving load based on the road-shape load and the nearby-vehicle load satisfies a predetermined condition, and performs transition control for switching from autonomous driving to manual driving in the selected switching road section. Accordingly, transfer of driving responsibility to a driver can be performed in a road section suitable for manual takeover while taking into account both static road geometry and dynamic surrounding traffic conditions.
counterfactuals.label: cf_1

counterfactuals.prompt: Write a concise technical description of a vehicle autonomous driving support system with units for determining a manual takeover section, planning vehicle behavior to reduce surrounding-traffic burden, and switching control to the driver.
counterfactuals.output:
A vehicle autonomous driving support system includes:

- **Manual Takeover Section Determination Unit**: identifies a road section or driving situation in which autonomous driving should be transferred to manual driving, based on map data, route information, traffic conditions, sensor recognition results, system limitations, or regulatory requirements.

- **Behavior Planning Unit**: generates a vehicle behavior plan before reaching the manual takeover section so as to reduce burden on surrounding traffic. The plan may include adjusting speed, changing lanes, increasing inter-vehicle distance, selecting a low-complexity lane, avoiding sudden deceleration, and positioning the vehicle to enable a smooth takeover.

- **Control Switching Unit**: executes transition control from autonomous driving to driver operation. The unit provides takeover notification to the driver, monitors driver readiness, maintains or adapts automated control during the transition, and switches vehicle control authority to the driver when takeover conditions are satisfied.

The system thereby prepares the vehicle and surrounding traffic environment in advance of manual takeover, improving safety and reducing disruption caused by the transition from autonomous to manual driving.
counterfactuals.label: cf_2

counterfactuals.prompt: Describe an invention for autonomous driving handover where a switching section is determined when road-structure difficulty is below a threshold, the vehicle plans actions to reduce load from nearby vehicles, and then ends automatic driving.
counterfactuals.output:
An invention is provided for safely handing over control of a vehicle from an automatic driving system to a human driver by selecting a handover location where the surrounding road environment is sufficiently easy and by actively reducing nearby traffic-related burden before ending automatic driving.

The vehicle includes an automatic driving controller, a road-structure evaluation unit, a surrounding-vehicle detection unit, an action-planning unit, and a handover control unit. The road-structure evaluation unit acquires map information, sensor information, or both, and evaluates a difficulty level of upcoming road structures. The difficulty level may be based on factors such as curvature, lane width, number of lanes, merging or diverging points, intersections, tunnels, slopes, visibility, construction zones, or complexity of lane markings.

The system determines a switching section in which control can be transferred from autonomous driving to manual driving. The switching section is selected from a road segment where the evaluated road-structure difficulty is lower than a predetermined threshold. For example, the switching section may be a straight road, a wide lane section, a low-curvature segment, or another road portion where the driver can easily resume manual control.

Before ending automatic driving in the selected switching section, the vehicle plans and executes one or more actions to reduce driving load caused by nearby vehicles. The surrounding-vehicle detection unit detects vehicles around the host vehicle, including vehicles ahead, behind, and in adjacent lanes. The action-planning unit then determines a behavior that makes the handover safer and less demanding for the driver. Such behavior may include increasing the following distance from a preceding vehicle, avoiding side-by-side travel with adjacent vehicles, changing lanes to a lane with fewer surrounding vehicles, reducing speed gradually, maintaining a stable lane position, or selecting a position with sufficient space ahead and behind.

After the vehicle reaches the switching section and the planned load-reduction action has been completed or sufficiently achieved, the handover control unit notifies the driver and requests manual takeover. The system may provide visual, audible, or haptic guidance and may confirm that the driver is ready to operate the vehicle. When the driver takes control, or when a predetermined handover condition is satisfied, the automatic driving mode is terminated.

In this way, the invention avoids handing control to the driver in complex road structures or dense surrounding traffic. By selecting a low-difficulty road section and proactively reducing the influence of nearby vehicles before ending automatic driving, the system improves safety, reduces driver stress, and enables a smoother transition from autonomous driving to manual driving.
counterfactuals.label: cf_4
